parameters: The Sayunaari have received your message, Lord Jaromir. They have departed and are bound for home.
Is there something more, my lord?
One last thing...\| Did their leader take kindly to our gifts?
Well, my lord, the female seemed somewhat crestfallen. Not about the gift, but something else. Perhaps they preferred to stay longer, my lord?
Donar, why have you given me this test...\| give me the strength to be free...
